reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for 185 seats.

That number comes from Dana's own posts in #north-team on 2025-08-20, a channel she's in. She first wrote 180 seats (amendment signed 2025-08-19), then corrected it a few minutes later: "It's 185, not 180."

I couldn't find the signed amendment in the shared files, so I haven't checked the number against the document itself. I told her June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if she wants to confirm it for the QBR deck. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it didn't need approval to share.
